system.notes:
Bite: Speed 9, Accuracy 11, Damage 10L, Defense 2, Rate 1

Claw: Speed 7, Accuracy 10, Damage 8L, Defense 4, Rate 2

Dragon's Suspire (freezing hail): Speed 10, Accuracy 5, Damage 8L, Defense 0, Rate 1

Essence Pool: 70. Dematerialize: 40m. Languages: Airtongue (native), Old Realm. Spirit Charms: Dematerialize, Essence Plethora x2, Landscape Camouflage (+3 dice to Stealth), Landscape Travel (fly), Measure the Wind, Natural Elemental Powers, Principle of Motion, Sense Domain. First Excellency: Athletics, Awareness, Dodge, Integrity, Martial Arts, Stealth. Breath captured in jars grants +3 auto-successes on Perception rolls to pierce illusions.
system.biography: Medium-sized air elementals taking the form of tremendous bears 12–14 feet tall with steaming breath, shining gold eyes and cloud-soft fur. Gentle wind-herders managing steady breezes. Serve the Wind Masters and function as shock troops in the Aerial Legion.
